name: WonderTone Music Studio
slogan: Rooted in Music. Driven by Curiosity.
tagline_main: Classical piano & violin lessons for curious young musicians
tagline_sub: Bilingual instruction in English & Mandarin · Ages 4+ · Exam Prep
contact_desc: We offer a complimentary trial lesson for all new students. Come meet our teachers, try an instrument, and see if WonderTone is the right fit for your family — no commitment required.
about_paragraphs: WonderTone Music Studio was founded on a simple belief: every child deserves music education that is both rigorous and joyful. We specialize in classical piano and violin, offering a nurturing environment where students build real technique alongside a genuine love for music.

We teach in both English and Mandarin (双语教学), and tailor every lesson to each student's unique pace, personality, and goals — whether they're stepping up to the piano for the very first time, or preparing for Certificate of Merit exams.
Our approach is encouraging, structured, and student-centered. Parents trust us to be patient and professional. Students trust us to make music feel alive.

practice_tips.title: The 20-Minute Rule
practice_tips.text: Short, focused practice sessions every day far outperform long sessions twice a week. Aim for 20–30 minutes daily with intentional, slow repetition of tricky passages.

practice_tips.title: Slow Before Fast
practice_tips.text: Always start new passages slowly enough to play them correctly. Speed follows accuracy — never the other way around. Use a metronome, even for slow practice.

practice_tips.title: Listen Actively
practice_tips.text: Listen to recordings of your current pieces and other classical music often. Your ears absorb phrasing, tone, and expression that transfers directly to your playing.
